Now powered by iCloud, so your budgets stay private and sync automatically across every device you own.

KEY FEATURES:

Private iCloud Sync
Sign in with Apple - no passwords to create or remember
Your data lives in your own private iCloud, never on our servers
Automatic sync across all your devices
Already have an account? Bring your existing budgets and transactions across in a few taps

Smart Budget Management
Set monthly budgets and track spending in real-time
Visual insights into your spending patterns
Get alerts when approaching budget limits

Comprehensive Analytics
Interactive spending charts and graphs
Category-based expense tracking
Income vs. expense comparisons
Spending trends over time

Multi-Account Support
Track multiple bank accounts and balances
Import statements from Revolut, AIB, Bank of Ireland, or any CSV/PDF
Automatic transaction categorization

Smart Categorization
AI-powered merchant recognition
Custom category creation

Quick filters and search

Secure & Private
No ads, no tracking
Your financial data stays yours

Beautiful & Intuitive:
Clean, modern interface
Dark mode support
Customizable spending categories
Easy-to-use transaction entry

Whether you're saving for a goal, trying to cut expenses, or just want to understand where your money goes, Loaded gives you the insights you need to make smarter financial decisions.

Perfect for:
Personal finance management
Budget planning
Expense tracking
Financial goal setting
Money saving

Download Loaded - The Personal Budgeting App today and start your journey to financial freedom!

review.notes:
HOW TO SIGN IN
This app uses "Sign in with Apple" as its only sign-in method for new users - please sign in with any Apple ID.

ICLOUD IS REQUIRED
All user data is stored privately in the user's own iCloud (CloudKit), not on our servers. Before signing in, please make sure the device is signed into iCloud (Settings -> [your name] -> iCloud). If iCloud is not available, the app shows a screen asking you to sign in to iCloud - this is expected.

SEEING A POPULATED APP (IMPORTANT)
Because data lives in each user's private iCloud, a brand-new sign-in starts empty. To review the app with realistic data:
1. Complete the short onboarding (you can tap "Skip intro", choose "No, I'm new here", enter any name, and set any budget).
2. Go to the Profile tab (top-right avatar) -> tap "Load Sample Data".
This populates example transactions, budgets, and account balances so you can review all features. "Remove Sample Data" clears it again.

ACCOUNT DELETION
Account deletion is available in Profile -> "Delete Account". It permanently removes all of the user's data from iCloud.

WHAT THE APP DOES
Loaded is a personal budgeting app: track spending, set monthly budgets by category, view analytics, and import transactions from bank statements (Revolut, AIB, Bank of Ireland, or CSV/PDF). It is ad-free and does not track users. No payment processing is involved.
